description: How the benchmark reads each prepared dataset (data/processed/<dataset>/records.parquet). Every text field is normalised once by make data (accents, case, punctuation and spacing; see dataset.normalise_text), except digits_fields, which keep only their digits; methods read the normalised records. text_fields are joined, in order and skipping nulls, into one text per record for TF-IDF blocking. Cora's fields are often misassigned by its parser, so all of them are used. match_fields are the fields the field-by-field (probabilistic) methods compare, each with how: jaro_winkler or levenshtein (string similarity levels) or exact. em_blocking are the rules Splink uses to train its match model with EM: a field (or SQL expression) records must share; EM cannot learn the weight of a field it blocks on, so the rules block on different fields; one-field datasets have none and keep Splink's default weights per similarity level. Title-only datasets run as-is (user's choice, 2026-10-16): the models then reduce to a similarity threshold on the title.
